metadata.name: Mytilus galloprovincialis laboratory experiment dataset
metadata.description: Laboratory measurements of physiological and chemical parameters (e.g., temperature, pH, salinity, DIC, CO₂, carbonate species, Omega) for the mussel Mytilus galloprovincialis under control and high CO₂ treatments across various developmental stages and time points. Includes replicate observations of cell stage, percentage metrics, and associated metadata such as treatment, time (hours), and experimental event.
